$comment: Information architecture of the kerimovdesigns.com replica. Derived from the clone's source: src/App.jsx (route table), src/engine/chunks/layout.js (shell + transitions), src/engine/chunks/924.js (page module 4656: mobile layouts <1024px, preloader 4760), src/engine/chunks/272.js (desktop WebGL gallery, project + About overlays), src/engine/chunks/notfound.js (404 scene), src/data/projects.json (10 projects). Desktop (>=1024px) and mobile (<1024px) are responsive variants of the same four templates; sections that only render at one breakpoint say so in their scope. Overlay routes (/about, /project/:id) render on top of the home gallery, which stays mounted and blurred behind them on desktop.

meta.source: https://www.kerimovdesigns.com/ (local replica in this project, verified against the live site with Playwright)
meta.generatedBy: ia-builder skill: ia.json hand-written from source; IA.md + matrix.csv generated by build.mjs

categories.SHELL: Persistent site chrome: the fixed meta navigation and the mobile footer.
categories.UTILITY: Runtime UI layered over the page (preloader, transitions, cursor, overlays, toasts); not content.
categories.INTRO: The opening statement block of the homepage: headline, portrait entry point, invitation copy.
categories.WORK: The portfolio index of projects, as a WebGL strip (desktop) or an image grid (mobile).
categories.PROJECT: Blocks of a single project's detail view: title, description, media, metadata, pagination.
categories.PROFILE: Blocks of the About view: designer identity, disciplines/services and their media.

shell.navbar.description: Fixed top navigation. Desktop: five label/value columns (Name, occupation, Location, Connect with Copy Email / Instagram / LinkedIn, Profile with About me) with staggered fade-up entrance. Mobile: collapses to the name on the left and an 'About me' toggle on the right.
shell.navbar.scope: Present on all 13 routes, both breakpoints.

utility.preloader.description: Full-screen loading cover with the 'KERIMOV DESIGNS' wordmark revealed left-to-right by a clip-path tied to asset-loading progress, then slid up out of view.
utility.preloader.scope: Shown once on first load of the 12 portfolio routes (home, about, project); not on the not-found route.

utility.page-transition.description: Route-change transition layer with its own WebGL canvas that covers the viewport while client-side navigation swaps the view.
utility.page-transition.scope: Mounted around every route by the root layout; active only during client-side navigation between the 12 portfolio routes.

utility.toast.description: Top-center toast host (light #ecebeb pill) available for transient confirmations.
utility.toast.scope: Mounted once in the root layout on all 13 routes.

intro.headline.description: Three-line uppercase bold statement 'Graphic designer / crafting visual identities, / typography and motion.' with word-by-word blur-and-rise reveal.
intro.headline.implementedBy: src/engine/chunks/272.js (desktop hero overlay ~L2400) + src/engine/chunks/924.js > b (mobile home)

intro.portrait-link.description: Small 4:5 portrait of the designer at the top right that opens the About view. Desktop renders it as a WebGL plane; mobile as a linked image.

intro.statement.description: Short invitation paragraph ('Take a look at my selected projects below…') pinned above the work strip at the right, revealed word by word.
intro.statement.scope: Homepage only (1 route), desktop breakpoint only.

work.strip-webgl.description: Infinite horizontal strip of project cover planes along the bottom of the viewport, driven by wheel/drag with damped inertia; the hovered plane stays sharp while the others blur and darken, and clicking a plane morphs it into the project view.
work.strip-webgl.scope: Desktop breakpoint on the 12 portfolio routes: interactive on home, and kept mounted (blurred behind the backdrop) under the about and project overlays.

utility.hover-title.description: Uppercase project title that follows the hovered plane's projected corner with matching perspective tilt, drawn with mix-blend-difference.
utility.hover-title.scope: Homepage only (1 route), desktop breakpoint only.

work.grid.description: 'Selected Work:' heading over a two-column grid of project cover images with uppercase titles, each linking to its project route.
work.grid.scope: Homepage only (1 route), mobile breakpoint only.

shell.footer-mobile.description: Mobile page footer listing Services (the five disciplines), Connect (Instagram, LinkedIn) and the design/development credit.
shell.footer-mobile.scope: Mobile breakpoint on the 12 portfolio routes; there is no footer on desktop.

utility.overlay-backdrop.description: Full-viewport dark (#0e0d0c at 97%) blurred backdrop that fades in behind an opened project or the About view, with a polygon cut-out tracking the active plane's bent outline.
utility.overlay-backdrop.scope: Desktop breakpoint on the 11 overlay routes (about plus every project).

utility.kinetic-cursor.description: Custom cursor label ('RETURN' / 'NEXT') that trails the pointer with velocity tilt and letter-spacing stretch, swapping to a small square over the media navigation; hides the native cursor.
utility.kinetic-cursor.scope: Desktop pointer devices on the 11 overlay routes (about plus every project).

project.header.description: Left-column project title (bold uppercase) and multi-paragraph description, revealed word by word.

project.media-stage.description: The selected cover plane enlarged to the center of the viewport; clicking or scrolling morphs through the project's images and finally its video with a noise-flow shader, then returns to the cover.
project.media-stage.implementedBy: src/engine/chunks/272.js > f (selected plane morph, fragment shader)

project.footer-bar.description: Bottom bar in three columns: 'Scroll or click to explore' hint, the project's tags joined with slashes, and numbered media pagination buttons.

project.mobile-header.description: Mobile article header with the project title revealed line by line.

project.mobile-media.description: Stacked full-width project images with the project video (autoplaying, muted) inline.

project.mobile-details.description: 'About the project:' description plus 'Year:' and 'Tools:' pairs for the mobile article.

profile.header.description: Left-column heading and two short paragraphs; starts on 'RUSTAM KERIMOV' with the bio and switches to the active discipline's own title and copy as the media stage advances.

profile.media-stage.description: The portrait plane enlarged to the center and morphed through one media item per discipline (portrait, four images and one video) on click/scroll.
profile.media-stage.implementedBy: src/engine/chunks/272.js > B (profile plane, media list E)

profile.discipline-list.description: Right-aligned list of six entries (Profile, Visual Identities, Logo Design, Art Direction, Motion & Animation, Editorial Design) highlighting the active one and jumping the media stage on click.

profile.footer-bar.description: Bottom-left meta line: 'Scroll or click to explore', location and age.

profile.mobile-intro.description: Mobile About opener: large portrait (rk-about), 'Behind The Work.' heading, two bio paragraphs and the location/age line.

profile.services-mobile.description: 'Services:' list of the five disciplines, each with a heading, its image or video, and a one-sentence description.

error.digits-scene.description: Full-viewport three.js scene where the digits 4-0-4 orbit and tumble, then snap into a row on a 6.5 s loop.

error.message.description: Bottom-left 'This page got lost.' heading, reassurance line, and a 'Back to portfolio' link with an animated arrow.
